name: French motorway tolls
law: Code de la voirie routière art. L122-4 and décret n° 95-81; tariffs set yearly by the concession contracts and the arrêtés of 28 January 2026 relatifs aux péages applicables sur les réseaux autoroutiers concédés, as published by each operator (A'liénor, ADELAC, ALIAE, APRR, AREA, ASF, ATMB, CEVM, Cofiroute, Escota, SAPN, Sanef). A trip pays the published entry-exit prices along its route, excluding 20% VAT. Stations placed with the ministry's toll station dataset (data.gouv.fr) and OpenStreetMap.

sources.title: Ministère de la Transition écologique: Gares de péage du réseau routier national concédé

tolled_roads: The conceded motorways of A'liénor, ADELAC, ALIAE, APRR, AREA, ASF, ATMB, CEVM, Cofiroute, Escota, SAPN, Sanef. Not included yet: Arcos (A355) and the smaller concessions (SFTRF's A43, ALiS, Albea, Alicorne, Atlandes, CCI Seine-Estuaire).
